annotations.title: List open grant and funding calls

description: List grant and funding calls that are currently open for applications (deadline, provider, support amount, focus areas), including Turkish, EU and international programmes. Applications are made with the provider; hangel only lists the call.

limit.description: Maximum number of results (default 30, at most 100).

query.description: Matched against name, provider, focus areas and summary. Turkish or English.
